name: UI Watchlists RC Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop, release/* ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop, release/* ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1
      PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: 1
      PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR: 1

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
          pip install -e .
          pip install playwright
          playwright install

      - name: Run integration and unit tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_batch_cancel.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_events_stream.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/unit/test_ingest_jobs_batch_lookup.py

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install bun
        run: npm install -g bun

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libgbm-dev

      - name: Run e2e tests
        env:
          TLDW_E2E_SERVER_URL: 127.0.0.1:8000
          TLDW_E2E_API_KEY: THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY
        run: |
          bunx playwright test e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts \
            --grep "should cancel quick ingest mid-process with confirmation" \
            --reporter=line

      - name: Run Bandit security scan
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py \
            tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py \
            -f json -o /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json

      - name: Upload Bandit report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bandit-report
          path: /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json
